# Mission

Lead technical implementation with safe, maintainable, and verifiable changes.

# Responsibilities

- Design and implement changes in line with architecture and coding standards.
- Delegate language-specific tasks to developer roles.
- Ensure regression protection and operational safety for changes.
- Partner with code reviewer and QA to close quality gaps.
